# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are recorded here, generated from git history.
A release is a tag or a version bump; a group is the commit-subject prefix; a task
reference is the `[spec:<feature>/<task>]` a snapshot or fleet worker tagged the commit with.

## [v6.11.00] - 2026-10-05

### Highlights

v6.11.00 completes the spec-driven implementation wave with sandbox lease escrow settlement, parallel scheduling gates, and Human KMS identity rotation. The release adds authenticated registry material, v5 program receipts across all SDKs, and a shared Programs admission policy. CI evidence, terminal qualifications, and native corpus coverage are recorded for all supported languages.

- Resolve compute disputes through a bisection game judged by ABI V5 market-step host call
- Run sandbox activities as metered program calls under lease-derived capabilities with escrow gate
- Add shared-namespace capability gate and declared access set gate for SDK output
- Record passing terminal v5 qualification across Rust, Go, Swift, TypeScript, and native
- Publish authenticated registry material and gate HPX distribution with immutable releases

## [hpx-registry-87945ae90ce045296d595537c140faabd028d724] - 2026-10-04

### Highlights

This release completes authenticated gateway wiring across the unified explorer, daemon, and SDK routes while advancing native execution, replay, and custody capabilities with real evidence and receipt verification. The Human interface gains wallet sponsorship consent, passkey-backed custody, and authenticated session recovery, and Programs modules register through canonical governance receipts with bounded interpreter conformance. MCP paid web tools route through authenticated daemon authority, and the agent fleet wires to canonical intent owners with durable approval and budget projections. Hundreds of scoped integration evidences, qualification handoffs, and bounded build outcomes close out prior gaps in native, Wasm, and replay coverage.

- Authenticated unified gateway routes HPX registration, explorer, daemon, SDK, and MCP traffic with canonical receipt verification
- Native execution and replay gains real evidence, sealed batch context, and receipt-bound settlement through daemon authority
- Human interface adds wallet sponsorship consent, passkey-backed custody, and authenticated session recovery
- Programs modules register through signed governance receipts with bounded interpreter conformance and capability wiring
- Agent daemon wires to canonical intent owners with durable approval budgets, receipt evidence, and authenticated admission

## [hpx-registry-d620ff70da24c9ab10257b6f898207571652f820] - 2026-10-02

### Highlights

This release centers on the Paxeer X bring-up completion and a major agent/wallet surface overhaul. The agent SDK ships a browser-safe entry and the API descriptor advances to schema minor 8, while the wallet and explorer mount behind the unified gateway with authenticated budget and allowance evidence. The daemon gains durable approvals, typed Program admission, attestor custody and checkpoint recovery, and program verification expands to kind-5 state bundles and source-bound runtime artifacts.

- Agent SDK browser export (`@sidiora/layerx-sdk/browser`), agent API schema minor 8, budget/export/policy dry-run/fee projection through Human owner
- Wallet and explorer behind unified gateway, authenticated wallet budget/allowance, wallet transfer completion from canonical transaction evidence
- Durable daemon approvals, typed Program admission, attestor custody, checkpoint archives, preparation lifecycle state across daemon restarts
- Program verification: kind-5 state bundles against authenticated chain head, source-bound runtime artifacts, ABI provenance, native capability snapshots
- Paxeer X bring-up: host-map probe, live check subcommands (hosts, rpc-nodes, archive-node, ca, hpx, explorer, wallet, developers, indexer, mirrors, search, interop, gas, bridge, internal, kernel-app, agent-public, human-session, ci), edge registration, RPC placement, kernel abort-points, finality-authority binding, fleet sync, wallet cutover

## [hpx-registry-a24f8294275d3e65cdaafaa1f2f6ba10ebe943ad] - 2026-09-29

### Highlights

This release unifies every Dockerfile under `docker/` with a repository-root build context and per-service ignore files, completes the wallet feature's attestor-gateway-SDK-app stack with a self-hosted PWA, brings the human service up behind the platform proxy with a plain listener and browser-origin allow-list, redoes the explorer home and scan pages on the new layout, and fixes the EVM RPC port conflict, the blocksync restart loop, and the giga fork-precompile hand-off height.

- `docker/` unification: all service Dockerfiles moved under `docker/` with root build context, per-file ignores, and a `containers check` script verifying layout and lint
- human service: plain listener behind the platform proxy with `LAYERX_HUMAN_LISTENER` and `LAYERX_HUMAN_WEB_ORIGIN` allow-list, browser boundary test
- wallet feature: complete attestor daemon, gateway, SDK, and self-hosted PWA app with threshold signing, EIP-1193 provider, ceremony tool, and provisioning
- explorer scan layout: home, transactions, blocks, address, token, kernel pages rebuilt on the scan shell and primitives with responsive specs
- fixes: EVM RPC stop-on-close (`fix/rpc-restart-stop`), blocksync stuck-only restart (`fix/selfremed-stuck-only`), giga fork-precompile hand-off height moved to 26300000

## [hpx-registry-27e6a3947f4058f916c82ad9e0946df10a0a8272] - 2026-09-21

### Highlights

This release ships the native LayerX anchor and custody modules with corresponding precompiles, replacing the Solidity settlement suite across the bring-up, custody, and checkpoint paths. The intent router now exposes intent.plan and intent.submit as part of the human API, with planIntent/submitPlan bindings in the TypeScript and Python SDKs and one shared conformance suite. Deposits are verified by light-client proof, the public network is served as beta from a single JSON-RPC endpoint, and the project is presented publicly as Paxeer-LX-Network.

- Native layerxAnchor and layerxCustody precompiles replace the Solidity custody and settlement suite
- Intent operations (intent.plan, intent.submit) with planIntent/submitPlan SDK bindings in TypeScript and Python
- Light-client proof verification for Paxeer deposits via the layerxVerify precompile
- Single JSON-RPC endpoint serving eth_, net_, and web3_ for the beta network
- Unified explorer page joining EVM addresses, did:layerx identifiers, and px accounts

## [hpx-registry-9e53bcf5c43c2f555f624a57cbe7dd36ec001d0a] - 2026-09-20

### Highlights

This release brings protocol 3 occupancy charging to the payer DID account across all SDKs, deploys the naming registry program during bring-up with explorer name resolution, and adds receipt-proven program value accounts to the CLI. The marketplace now signs calls with fee limits covering their declared budget, and receipt protocol version selection is configurable. Additional work covers paginated asset listing alignment, interop conformance suite ownership, wave 8 task gates, and Jev advisory tooling.

- Protocol 3 occupancy charge debits the payer DID account in TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs
- Naming registry program deployed during bring-up; explorer resolves names through signed naming reads
- Marketplace calls signed with fee limits covering declared budget; shared-storage authority granted
- Receipt protocol version selected from configuration; wrapped program registry documents read by SDKs
- CLI aligns with paginated lx_listAssets; `program registry get` accepts value_accounts blocks

## [pre-rebase-c2] - 2026-09-09

### Highlights

This release records extensive qualification evidence for PAY5 aggregate and payment flows, restores vendored Programs test coverage, and binds program signers to canonical payment accounts. It applies canonical Rust formatting across aggregate workspaces, enforces dynamic descriptor limits on guest execution grants, and adds bounded LXT-20 request encoding with runtime parser vectors. Native build, focused ledger gates, and beta-ledger-check pass throughout, while remaining blockers for Swift qualification and WAL publication are documented.

- Record completed PAY5 aggregate qualification and payment qualification evidence, superseding vendored-workspace and SDK-toolchain blockers.
- Bind program signers to canonical payment accounts and settlement commitments while preserving signer-DID authorization.
- Enforce dynamic descriptor limits on guest execution grants, narrowing root and nested program spending.
- Add bounded LXT-20 request encoding and runtime parser vectors covering all seven request methods.
- Restore vendored Programs test coverage (wasmi, parity-wasm, wasm-instrument) and pass full workspace Clippy with vendor tests enabled.

## [hpx-registry-f684eadb663872e759cfdb9a9093dc9a88d44304] - 2026-09-09

### Highlights

This release ships the HPX registry with authenticated deployment proofs and journal pairs, native owner registration with custody evidence and the LXIP identity provider, a hosted Human service with TLS and restricted ingress, Programs workspace runtime with call activity and module registry, agentd with MCP/A2A support and maintenance attachment verification, multi-language SDKs with terminal verification, a beta cluster with topology and guarantor checkpoint production, and a full Apache 2.0 relicense with rewritten documentation.

- `hpx-registry`: authenticated deployment proofs, journal pairs, cgroup delegation, and registry ingress gates
- `layerx-agentd`: MCP/A2A installation, maintenance attachment verification, and durable session revocation
- Programs workspace: call activity ingress, lifecycle management, module registry generation, and ABI v2 bindings
- Hosted Human service: identity provisioning through LXIP, protected evidence assembly, and TLS-terminated endpoints
- SDKs: terminal verification across Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, JVM, Swift, and .NET with signed vector conformance
- Beta cluster: topology qualification, bonded guarantors, checkpoint submitter, and settlement gates
- Apache 2.0 relicense with NOTICE, CITATION.cff, CODEOWNERS, and rewritten README/changelog
- Documentation: wiki Protocol/Modules/Finality/Custody pages, Paxeer subtree README, multi-language translations, and Keep a Changelog format

## [hpx-registry-548b4b2bf4851bbe79df8266fe7fee2b88104cd4] - 2026-09-07

### Highlights

LayerX Network ships as a public release under Apache 2.0 with a rewritten README, seven new translations, and full documentation aligned to the renamed repository. The release adds beta qualification gates and a beta driver, documents every hosted service (registry, gateway, webhooks, authority, core, identity), and verifies SDK terminal verification across Python, TypeScript, JVM, Swift, .NET, and Go. Programs runtime strict lint and 408 runtime tests pass, the agent boundary gains durable admission, and the changelog is now kept in Keep a Changelog format with area labels and auto-labeled PRs.

- Renamed product to LayerX Network; relicensed under Apache 2.0; public README and 7 translations added
- `beta-ledger-check`, beta qualification gates, and beta driver added; hosted services documented
- SDK terminal verification verified in Python, TypeScript, JVM, Swift, .NET, Go
- Programs runtime: strict Clippy repairs, 408 tests pass, emulator and sandbox gates recorded
- Agent boundary: durable admission, maintained batch verification, finality evidence recovery

## [hpx-registry-5a5c9380d4530731fad1cb5a46e8856b14a863ea] - 2026-08-26

### Highlights

This release completes the ABI v2 SDK and porting bindings, freezes the Programs ABI version two, and finishes the executable interoperability gateway. It hardens Paxeer, Autobahn, and Human trust boundaries, binds deposits to signed custody roots, and rejects invalid consensus and height ranges. The platform CLI, ramp request parsing, and gateway credential handling are fixed, while workspace build gates, reproducible tooling, and the public HPX registry deployment are finalized.

- Finish ABI v2 SDK and porting bindings
- Freeze Programs ABI version two
- Fix platform CLI seed and request handling
- Bind Human deposits to signed Paxeer custody roots
- Complete the public HPX registry deployment

## [hpx-registry-9a38f520ef277cece55eaf561096f890faf15cf5] - 2026-08-25

### Highlights

This release ships the Programs runtime as a real execution layer with deploy/call/upgrade/migration lifecycle, deterministic metering, and fuzz qualification, alongside the Paxeer Network import into the monorepo and multichain mirror publishing for Ethereum and Solana. The platform CLI gains workspace, MCP, and A2A install commands; the JVM, Go, Swift/C#, TypeScript, and Python SDKs reach production; and the human plane adds onboarding, custody, agent, approval, notification, and settings surfaces with full e2e coverage. Hosted webhooks, developer dashboards, a receipt-verifying gateway, testnet control plane, and faucet join the interop and security tooling.

- `workspace` subcommand installs, builds, and tests every repository module
- `install mcp` / `install a2a` register scoped MCP and A2A servers
- Programs runtime: deploy/call/upgrade/migration lifecycle with deterministic metering and fuzz gates
- Multichain mirror publisher with durable Ethereum and Solana publishing and migration tooling
- JVM SDK (Java/Kotlin), Go, Swift/C#, TypeScript, and Python SDKs shipped with conformance suites
